description:
About SuperApp

 AI was single-player. SuperApp makes it multiplayer. 

 SuperApp is building the AI collaboration super app—a shared workspace where people and leading AI models think, create, and make decisions together in real time. Instead of splitting communication, AI assistance, and content creation across separate tools, SuperApp brings group messaging, multi-model intelligence, and collaborative creation into one continuous experience.

 Teams can move from an initial conversation to a finished document, presentation, spreadsheet, or interactive app without losing the sources, decisions, feedback, and context that shaped the work. SuperApp is multi-provider by design: people can choose, pin, or compare leading models, while the platform can route each step to the capability best suited to the task. ( superapp.chat )

 Our Engineering Team architects the underlying operating system, core services, platform infrastructure, dev toolkits, core algorithms, machine learning models, packaged end-user apps, and app store marketplace. SuperApp engineers are excited to solve hard problems for complex organizations and are self-starters from day one. 

 As a Software Engineer , you’ll design and develop SuperApp services and applications, touching various layers of the stack. Our product and infrastructure is written in Go, Python, Java, and C++. Our tech stack is React and Typescript on the frontend. We operate using the micro-services model and leverage Docker and Kubernetes for our deployments. 

 We're hiring across all teams and technical areas, which includes Product Engineering and Infrastructure Engineering! 

 What you’ll do: 

 
 Collaborate with other engineers, product designers, and product managers to drive new features and applications from ideation to implementation to production 

 Develop the user interfaces of applications, the core platform, and reusable components 

 Evaluating new frontend libraries and technologies to fit our needs and iterating on and maintaining Instabase's frontend stack 

 Develop new features that can be leveraged by the other Instabase teams to develop apps and solutions 

 Move fast and be empowered to make product and design decisions. You will start contributing to our codebase during your first week, and as an early team member, you will help shape the UI and direction of our product 

 
 About you: 

 
 Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD program in Computer Science, Human Computer Interaction, Applied Mathematics, Computer Engineering, or a degree in a related field 

 Preferred graduation date between May 2027 - June 2027 

 Proficient in one of more of the following languages and frameworks: Python, Go, React, and REST APIs. 

 Solid communication and collaboration and a strong eagerness to learn 

 
 Benefits: 

 
 Flexible PTO: Because life is better when you actually live it!

 Comprehensive Coverage: Top-notch medical, dental, and vision insurance.

 Parental Leave & Fertility Benefits: Supporting you in growing your family, your way.

 Therapy Sessions Covered: Mental health matters—10 free sessions through Samata Health.

 Wellness Stipend: For gym memberships, fitness tech, or whatever keeps you thriving.

 Lunch on Us: Enjoy a lunch credit when you’re in the office.

 
 #Li-Hybrid 
 SuperApp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Research shows that in order to apply for a job, women feel they need to meet 100% of the criteria while men usually apply after meeting about 60%. Regardless of how you identify, if you believe you can do the job and are a good match, we encourage you to apply.
